Name: Keoladeo National Park
Description: A famous avifauna sanctuary that hosts thousands of birds, especially during winter. Also known as Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary.

Name: Jantar Mantar, Jaipur
Description: An astronomical observation site built by Maharaja Jai Singh II. Features the world's largest stone sundial.

Name: Hill Forts of Rajasthan
Description: A serial nomination of six majestic forts in Rajasthan including Amber Fort, Chittorgarh, Gagron Fort, Jaisalmer Fort, Kumbhalgarh, and Ranthambore.

Name: Jaipur City
Description: The Pink City of Jaipur, founded in 1727. Known for its unique urban planning and architectural harmony.
